metadata.description: Primary references for safe refactoring, codemod verification, contract testing, migration rollouts, and CI quality gates. Prefer official docs for volatile tooling guidance.
metadata.title: QA Refactoring - Sources

refactoring_foundations.name: Martin Fowler - Refactoring (Book)
refactoring_foundations.description: Canonical refactoring reference and catalog entry point.

refactoring_foundations.name: Refactoring.Guru - Refactoring Catalog
refactoring_foundations.description: Refactoring patterns with examples; useful for mapping smells to safe moves.

refactoring_foundations.name: Refactoring.Guru - Code Smells
refactoring_foundations.description: Code smell identification and remediation hints.

refactoring_foundations.name: Tidy First? - Kent Beck (Book, O'Reilly, 2023)
refactoring_foundations.description: Small, reversible "tidyings" done before a risky change, framed as an economic (coupling/cohesion, optionality) rather than moral decision. Verified via web search 2026-07-11.

legacy_code_safety.name: Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Book)
legacy_code_safety.description: Seams, characterization tests, and incremental refactoring strategies.

legacy_code_safety.name: ApprovalTests
legacy_code_safety.description: Approval and golden-master testing workflows across languages.

legacy_code_safety.name: Martin Fowler - Strangler Fig Application
legacy_code_safety.description: Incremental modernization pattern for legacy systems.

codemods_and_contracts.name: OpenRewrite - Recipe Testing
codemods_and_contracts.description: Testing guidance for large-scale semantic rewrites.

codemods_and_contracts.name: ast-grep - Rewrite Rule
codemods_and_contracts.description: Pattern-based AST rewrites for codemods and safe mechanical edits.

codemods_and_contracts.name: Pact Documentation
codemods_and_contracts.description: Consumer/provider contract testing for boundary-preserving refactors.

quality_gates.name: ESLint - Configuration Files
quality_gates.description: Current flat-config guidance for JavaScript/TypeScript linting.

quality_gates.name: Prettier - Integrating with Linters
quality_gates.description: Current guidance on keeping formatting separate from linting.

quality_gates.name: SonarQube Server 2026.1 LTA - Quality Gates
quality_gates.description: Quality gate configuration for SonarQube 2026.1 LTA, including Sonar way for AI Code and MCP server integration.

quality_gates.name: SonarQube Server 2026.1 LTA - Installation Requirements
quality_gates.description: Current supported runtime and host requirements for SonarQube Server 2026.1 LTA.

rollout_and_ci.name: LaunchDarkly - Migration Flags
rollout_and_ci.description: Stage-based rollout control for legacy migrations and branch-by-abstraction cutovers.

rollout_and_ci.name: GitHub Actions - Automating Builds and Tests
rollout_and_ci.description: CI workflow building blocks for refactor safety.

rollout_and_ci.name: GitHub Actions - Caching Dependencies
rollout_and_ci.description: Keep refactor verification pipelines fast and repeatable.

optional_ai_automation.name: GitHub Copilot Coding Agent - Create Skills
optional_ai_automation.description: Official guidance for agent skills and task-specific operating instructions.

optional_ai_automation.name: OpenRewrite - AI-Powered Recipe Authoring (Moderne)
optional_ai_automation.description: How the Moderne CLI MCP server exposes OpenRewrite recipes as deterministic tool calls for AI coding agents. Primary reference for OpenRewrite + AI agent workflows.

optional_ai_automation.name: jssg - JavaScript ast-grep (Codemod)
optional_ai_automation.description: JavaScript/TypeScript-authored ast-grep transforms via jssg, announced October 2025. Write polyglot codemods in TypeScript using ast-grep as the matching engine.

optional_ai_automation.name: SonarQube Server 2026.1 LTA - What's New
optional_ai_automation.description: SonarQube 2026.1 LTA: MCP server integration, 50% faster JS/TS/Python/Kotlin analysis, Rust and Swift 6.2 support, AI Code Assurance improvements.

mutation_testing.name: Stryker Mutator
mutation_testing.description: Mutation testing framework for JavaScript, TypeScript, and .NET. Primary reference for Stryker configuration, runners, and incremental mutation.

mutation_testing.name: mutmut (Python mutation testing)
mutation_testing.description: Lightweight Python mutation tester; integrates with pytest. Primary reference for mutmut usage and CI integration.

mutation_testing.name: PIT (Pitest) - Java/Kotlin mutation testing
mutation_testing.description: Mature mutation testing system for JVM languages. Primary reference for PIT Maven/Gradle configuration and incremental history mode.

mutation_testing.name: cosmic-ray (Python mutation testing)
mutation_testing.description: Session-based Python mutation tester with distributed (Celery) execution support. Primary reference for large-scale Python mutation runs.
